import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import Polygon, FancyArrowPatch, PathPatch from matplotlib.path import Path
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#263238", "svg.fonttype": "none", })
BLUE = "#33658A" RED = "#C66B4E" INK = "#263238" GRAY = "#89959B"
A = np.array([[2., 1.], [0., 2.]]) e1 = np.array([1., 0.]) e2 = np.array([0., 1.]) v = e1 + e2 square = np.array([[0., 0.], e1, v, e2]) mapped_square = square @ A.T
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(6.8, 3.8), dpi=100) ax_left = fig.add_axes([0.065, 0.18, 0.345, 0.62]) ax_right = fig.add_axes([0.535, 0.18, 0.435, 0.62])
def setup_axes(ax, xlim, ylim, xmax, ymax, xname, yname): ax.set_xlim(*xlim) ax.set_ylim(*ylim) ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box") ax.axis("off") for end in [(xmax, 0), (0, ymax)]: ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( (0, 0), end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=8, linewidth=0.85, color=GRAY, zorder=1, clip_on=False )) ax.annotate("$0$", (0, 0), xytext=(-7, -10), textcoords="offset points", fontsize=9, color=GRAY, ha="right", va="top") ax.annotate(xname, (xmax, 0), xytext=(3, -2), textcoords="offset points", fontsize=10, color=GRAY, va="center") ax.annotate(yname, (0, ymax), xytext=(-4, 4), textcoords="offset points", fontsize=10, color=GRAY, ha="center")
def vector(ax, endpoint, color): ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( (0, 0), endpoint, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=12, linewidth=2.0, color=color, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, zorder=4 ))
setup_axes(ax_left, (-0.18, 1.42), (-0.28, 1.39), 1.31, 1.28, "$x_1$", "$x_2$") setup_axes(ax_right, (-0.24, 3.64), (-0.45, 2.65), 3.45, 2.48, "$y_1$", "$y_2$")
for ax, vertices in [(ax_left, square), (ax_right, mapped_square)]: ax.add_patch(Polygon( vertices, closed=True, facecolor=BLUE, edgecolor="none", alpha=0.09, zorder=0 )) ax.plot(vertices[1:4, 0], vertices[1:4, 1], color=GRAY, linewidth=1.0, linestyle=(0, (3, 3)), zorder=2)
for endpoint, color in [(e1, BLUE), (e2, RED), (v, INK)]: vector(ax_left, endpoint, color) for endpoint, color in [(A @ e1, BLUE), (A @ e2, RED), (A @ v, INK)]: vector(ax_right, endpoint, color)
ax_left.text(0.54, -0.18, r"$\vec{e}_1=(1,0)$", color=BLUE, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=10) ax_left.text(0.02, 1.085, r"$\vec{e}_2=(0,1)$", color=RED, ha="left", va="bottom", fontsize=10) ax_left.text(0.47, 0.69, r"$\vec{v}=(1,1)$", color=INK, ha="center", va="bottom", rotation=45, rotation_mode="anchor", fontsize=10)
ax_right.text(1.55, -0.23, r"$T(\vec{e}_1)=(2,0)$", color=BLUE, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=10) ax_right.text(0.80, 2.17, r"$T(\vec{e}_2)=(1,2)$", color=RED, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=10) ax_right.text(2.85, 2.17, r"$T(\vec{v})=(3,2)$", color=INK, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=10)
# The transformation is written explicitly using a compact, typeset matrix. fig.text(0.437, 0.912, r"$\mathbf{A}=$", ha="right", va="center", fontsize=13) matrix_x = [0.467, 0.507] matrix_y = [0.936, 0.888] for row in range(2): for col in range(2): fig.text(matrix_x[col], matrix_y[row], rf"${int(A[row, col])}$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=12)
for x, direction in [(0.447, 1), (0.527, -1)]: verts = [ (x + direction * 0.010, 0.961), (x, 0.961), (x, 0.863), (x + direction * 0.010, 0.863), ] bracket = PathPatch( Path(verts, [Path.MOVETO, Path.LINETO, Path.LINETO, Path.LINETO]), transform=fig.transFigure, fill=False, color=INK, linewidth=1.1 ) fig.add_artist(bracket)
fig.add_artist(FancyArrowPatch( (0.365, 0.765), (0.635, 0.765), transform=fig.transFigure, connectionstyle="arc3,rad=-0.32", arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=12, linewidth=1.2, color=INK )) fig.text(0.5, 0.808, r"$\mathbf{A}$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=12, bbox={"facecolor": "white", "edgecolor": "none", "pad": 1.5})
fig.text(0.238, 0.075, r"$\vec{v}=\vec{e}_1+\vec{e}_2$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11) fig.text(0.751, 0.075, r"$T(\vec{v})=T(\vec{e}_1)+T(\vec{e}_2)$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11)
